title: Alpha-Beta Pruning via Monadic Continuations
abstract: arXiv:2611.32320v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Alpha-beta pruning is a fundamental technique in game-playing AI, enabling efficient minimax search by avoiding the exploration of branches that cannot affect the optimal decision. We present a monadic formulation of alpha-beta pruning based on the combination of the continuation monad and the reader monad. Unlike previous approaches that encode alpha-beta bounds into the types of available moves, our construction records these bounds within monadic outcomes, leaving the move types unchanged. We further show that the ordinary continuation monad suffices to compute not only optimal outcomes but also optimal plays, by extending the outcome type to include the corresponding sequences of moves. This provides an alternative to generalisations of the continuation monad proposed to address the inefficiencies associated with the selection monad in alpha-beta search. tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于延续单子与读取器单子组合的Alpha-Beta剪枝新表述，将搜索界限记录在单子结果中而非走法类型中，并证明普通延续单子即可同时计算最优结果与最优走法序列。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a monadic formulation of alpha-beta pruning combining the continuation and reader monads, recording alpha-beta bounds within monadic outcomes rather than move types, and shows that the ordinary continuation monad suffices to compute both optimal outcomes and optimal plays.
